title: A Choir for the Spire
author: Sable Okafor
blurb: Ivo Montrose, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
